title: Matka Pro - Advanced Matka Gambling App Frontend Implementation

requirements.summary: Create Admin panel page with result declaration, market management, deposit/withdrawal approval, and platform statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel is hidden from non-admin users
Admin can declare open and close numbers for any active market
Admin can approve or reject pending deposit/withdrawal requests
Admin sees total platform stats: active users, total bets today, total payout today
Admin actions trigger immediate backend state updates

file_operations.description: Create admin-only page with tabs for result declaration, market management, deposit/withdrawal request approval, and platform statistics. Use the authorization component to verify admin role via isCallerAdmin() before rendering admin controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Form component for declaring game results with inputs for market selection, open number, close number, Jodi, and Panna arrays. Calls declareGameResult() backend method.
Table displaying pending deposit requests with approve/reject actions. Fetches data via getPendingDepositRequests() and calls approveDepositRequest() or rejectDepositRequest().
Table displaying pending withdrawal requests with approve/reject actions. Fetches data via getPendingWithdrawalRequests() and calls approveWithdrawalRequest() or rejectWithdrawalRequest().
Dashboard card component showing platform statistics (active users, total bets, total payout, etc.) fetched via getPlatformStats().
Table for managing market open/close status. Fetches markets via getAllMarkets() and updates status via updateMarketStatus().
React Query hooks for admin operations: fetching pending requests, platform stats, declaring results, and approving/rejecting requests.

requirements.summary: Build Market Lobby page showing all active Matka markets with name, times, last result, and status
acceptanceCriteria: Market lobby shows all seeded markets with name, open/close time, and status
Last result is displayed in standard Matka format (e.g., 3 45 6)
Markets with closed betting show a disabled state
Clicking a market navigates to the bet placement page for that market
Unauthenticated users see a login prompt before accessing bet placement

file_operations.description: Main lobby page displaying all markets as cards. Use the authorization component to check authentication state before allowing navigation to bet placement. Fetches markets via getAllMarkets(). Each market card shows name, open/close time, last result, and status. Clicking navigates to /bet/:marketId. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Card component for individual market display showing name, times, last result in Matka format, and status badge. Disabled state when betting is closed.
React Query hooks for fetching markets via getAllMarkets() and individual market details via getGameType().

requirements.summary: Build Bet Placement page supporting all bet types (Single, Jodi, Single/Double/Triple Panna) with amount input, balance validation, and confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: All five bet types are selectable with appropriate number input constraints
Minimum bet amount is ₹10 (1000 paise)
Current wallet balance is displayed and validated before submission
On successful bet, balance is deducted and a confirmation with expected payout is shown
Backend rejects bets if market is closed or balance is insufficient
Expected payout is calculated and shown before confirmation

file_operations.description: Bet placement page with market context from route params. Use the authorization component to enforce user authentication before allowing bet placement. Displays current balance from getCallerUserProfile(), bet type selector, number input with validation, amount input (min ₹10), expected payout calculation, and confirmation dialog. Calls placeBet() backend method. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Component for selecting bet type (Single, Jodi, Single Panna, Double Panna, Triple Panna) with appropriate UI for each type.
Input component for bet numbers with validation based on selected bet type (0-9 for Single, 00-99 for Jodi, Panna combinations).
Confirmation dialog showing bet details (type, number, amount) and expected payout based on standard Matka odds.
React Query hooks for placing bets via placeBet() and calculating expected payouts based on bet type and amount.
Utility functions for calculating expected payouts based on standard Matka odds (Single 9x, Jodi 90x, Single Panna 150x, Double Panna 300x, Triple Panna 600x).

requirements.summary: Build Wallet page with balance display, deposit/withdrawal request forms, and transaction history
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet page shows balance in formatted INR (e.g., ₹1,250.00)
Deposit form accepts amount and UTR reference and submits to backend as a pending request
Withdrawal form accepts amount and UPI ID and submits to backend as a pending request
Transaction history lists all wallet events with date, type, amount, and status
Deposit and withdrawal requests show pending/approved/rejected status

file_operations.description: Wallet page displaying balance from getCallerUserProfile(), deposit/withdrawal forms, and transaction history. Use the authorization component to enforce user authentication. Calls submitDepositRequest() and submitWithdrawalRequest() backend methods. Displays transactions via getTransactionHistory(). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Form for submitting deposit requests with amount input and UTR reference field. Calls submitDepositRequest().
Form for submitting withdrawal requests with amount input and UPI ID field. Validates sufficient balance. Calls submitWithdrawalRequest().
Table displaying all wallet transactions (deposits, withdrawals, bet placements, winnings) with date, type, amount, and status. Fetched via getTransactionHistory().
React Query hooks for wallet operations: fetching transaction history via getTransactionHistory(), submitting deposit/withdrawal requests, and invalidating balance after transactions.
Update currency utilities to support INR formatting (converting paise bigint to ₹X,XXX.XX format) and parsing INR input to paise bigint for backend submission.

requirements.summary: Build My Bets / Results page showing user's bet history with outcome and payout
acceptanceCriteria: All bets for the authenticated user are fetched and displayed
Each bet row shows market, type, number, amount, and outcome
Won bets show the payout amount in green; lost bets in red; pending in amber
Bets are grouped by date, newest first

file_operations.description: Page displaying authenticated user's bet history. Use the authorization component to enforce user authentication. Fetches bets via getBetHistory() and displays them grouped by date with color-coded outcomes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Table component displaying bet history rows with market name, bet type, selected number, amount, result (won/lost/pending), and payout. Color-codes outcomes: green for won, red for lost, amber for pending.
React Query hooks for fetching user bet history via getBetHistory() and grouping bets by date.

requirements.summary: Apply bold Indian Matka visual theme with dark background, red/gold accents, traditional motifs, and mobile-first layout
acceptanceCriteria: App title, logo area, and page title reflect Matka branding
Color scheme uses dark background with red/gold accents consistently
Navigation includes: Markets, My Bets, Wallet, and Admin (admin only)
All APK-related pages, routes, and components are removed
Layout is mobile-first and usable on small screens

file_operations.description: Update page title to 'Matka Pro — Advanced Matka Gambling Platform' and set favicon to the generated Matka logo workspace/frontend/public/assets/generated/matka-logo.dim_256x256.png.

Replace existing theme with Matka-specific dark theme using deep red (#8B0000, #DC143C) and gold (#FFD700, #DAA520) OKLCH values. Update CSS custom properties for backgrounds, accents, borders, and text to match Matka branding. Add utility classes for Matka-specific styling (e.g., neon-red-glow, gold-border).

Update Tailwind config with Matka color palette (matkaRed, matkaGold, matkaDark) and traditional Indian fonts suitable for gambling (e.g., bold sans-serif for numbers). Configure custom shadows and gradients for Matka wheel/card motifs.

Replace APK-related branding with Matka branding. Update header to show Matka Pro logo (workspace/frontend/public/assets/generated/matka-logo.dim_256x256.png) and navigation links: Markets, My Bets, Wallet, Admin (conditional on isCallerAdmin()). Use the authorization component to conditionally show the Admin link. Remove scanline overlay and APK footer copy. Add LoginButton component for authentication. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Login/logout button component using the authorization component's useInternetIdentity hook. Displays 'Login' when unauthenticated, 'Logout' when authenticated, and handles login/logout flow with query cache clearing on logout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Modal for first-time user profile setup, asking for username. Use the authorization component's getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile methods. Shown only when user is authenticated but has no profile. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Full-screen component shown when non-admin users attempt to access admin routes. Displays 'Access Denied' message with Matka branding and a link back to the market lobby.

Replace existing routes with Matka app routes: / (MarketLobby), /bet/:marketId (BetPlacement), /my-bets (MyBets), /wallet (Wallet), /admin (AdminPanel). Remove APKEditor and JobHistory routes. All routes nested under Layout. Wire ProfileSetupModal at root level to handle first-time user setup.
Remove APK editor page as it is replaced by Matka functionality.
Remove job history page as it is replaced by Matka functionality.
Remove APK job history table component.
Remove APK patch job queries hook.
Remove APK parser utility.
Remove APK patcher utility.
Wire generated Matka logo (workspace/frontend/public/assets/generated/matka-logo.dim_256x256.png) as static asset for use in header and favicon.
Wire generated Matka hero banner (workspace/frontend/public/assets/generated/matka-hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png) as static asset for use on the MarketLobby page hero section.

Add hero section at top of MarketLobby page displaying the generated Matka hero banner (workspace/frontend/public/assets/generated/matka-hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png) with welcome text and branding. This is added to an existing required page, not a new homepage.
